title: kate-core: indent an XML line after an opening tag
summary: xml_newline copies the indent of the text before the caret and adds one unit when the last tag in that text is an opening element tag. A closing tag, a self-closing tag, a processing instruction, a comment, and a doctype add nothing.

lane.reason: Either lane may code this packet. It is one file, one behavior, and one test, and the rule text in this packet is the oracle. The first idle lane takes it.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary:
Find the last < in the text before the caret and the > after it; the tag opens an element when the text after < does not start with /, ?, or !, and the text before > does not end with /. No tag or an unclosed tag adds nothing. Add #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))] until newline_for_indenter calls it. The test xml_newline_indents_after_an_opening_tag asserts gives one unit, gives one unit, gives none,
gives none, gives none, and text gives none. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.
